affected_system: multimodal evacuation, assisted transport, and emergency access network
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time
pair departure-choice and dynamic network forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Evacuation demand, assistance eligibility, vehicle capacity, route state, and hazard timing are versioned.
Compliance, household departure, and network degradation remain observed inputs or bounded scenarios.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time.

constraints.description: The evacuation and emergency mobility forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: emergency transportation coordinator and incident commander
decision_question: What departure, assisted-transport, congestion, and clearance-time range follows the hazard envelope?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The evacuation and emergency mobility forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.primary_outcome: people remaining in hazard areas after safe clearance time

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: people remaining in hazard areas after safe clearance time
distributional gap in people remaining in hazard areas after safe clearance time
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present behavioral assumptions or simulated clearance as actual evacuation.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for hazard-specific evacuation demand and clearance time passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast evacuation demand and clearance time
